name: No Flowers Required
source: Your life is a complete wreck. With only six months to save your failing flower shop, you sell your dream house and move to an apartment to try and save money. Unfortunately, this new apartment is a little bit… leaky. Lucky for you, that hot mysterious handyman you just met can fix anything. From broken sinks to broken hearts to broken futures, Dillon James has all the right tools under his belt, and you can’t help but wonder if this handyman might secretly be a Prince Charming in disguise.
